title: 美银预判：中央经济工作会议只微调，大规模刺激要等到何时？
speaker: Helen Qiao

segments.en: We have been out the view that we are, we probably see, we'll see further deterioration of domestic demand.
segments.zh: 我们一直认为，国内需求可能进一步走弱。

segments.en: And that definitely puts us in the position where we should see more policy-easing measures.
segments.zh: 这显然意味着，我们应该会看到更多宽松措施。

segments.en: This definitely warrants more counter-cyclical policy adjustment for no question.
segments.zh: 这无疑需要更多逆周期政策调整。

segments.en: However, we wonder whether the central economic working conference is going to set us quite a drastically different tone.
segments.zh: 不过，我们想知道中央经济工作会议是否会定下截然不同的基调。

segments.en: Because after all, I think that they still want to appear to be overall speaking, economically, relatively stable.
segments.zh: 毕竟，我认为他们仍希望整体经济看起来相对稳定。

segments.en: And therefore, they only want to adjust on the margin, not necessarily pivot by 180 degrees of saying
segments.zh: 因此，他们只想边际调整，而不一定180度转向说

segments.en: that we are going to massively stimulate whatever it takes.
segments.zh: 我们要不惜一切代价大规模刺激。

segments.en: That I think is very unlikely. With that said, if it is only incremental easing, in the near future, I'm afraid that CWC is probably only
segments.zh: 我认为这非常不可能。话虽如此，如果只是渐进宽松，短期内我担心中央经济工作会议可能只会

segments.en: going to say that, oh, on the margin, and we're going to make all these easing measures more effective, and we'll try to coordinate physical and monetary policies better.
segments.zh: 说，哦，边际上，我们将让所有这些宽松措施更有效，并更好地协调财政和货币政策。

segments.en: Instead of saying that, OK, we need to maximize everything.
segments.zh: 而不是说，好，我们需要最大化一切。

segments.en: To a certain extent, they're probably expecting that things could actually get worse from here in 2027, 2028.
segments.zh: 某种程度上，他们可能预期2027、2028年情况会变得更糟。

segments.en: And therefore, there is probably this willingness to hold back some of the stimulus so that they can be used when it is needed the most.
segments.zh: 因此，他们可能愿意保留一些刺激措施，以便在最需要时使用。

segments.en: In other words, the type of bazooka, type of policy package still has to wait.
segments.zh: 换句话说，那种重磅政策方案仍需等待。

segments.en: And that's because exports are doing well,
segments.zh: 这是因为出口表现良好，
